(b) Is fixedAway the RIGHT object — does it actually denote (A_b)^G, or does the letI action make it something else? Is awayMapMulSemiringAction's smul really awayMap?
(c) Does my claim (3) overstate? SymPowInvariantsLocalization says the equality needs to be a ring isomorphism / IsLocalization statement; I prove an ELEMENTWISE biconditional and argue in §3 that this is what consumers apply. Is that argument honest, or is it a weakening dressed as a choice?
(d) Claim 4: verify by reading AlbaneseUP.lean at the six sorry sites (they are around lines 413/457/502/541/593/629 pre-edit).
(e) Any prose in the three touched files that is now stale or contradicts another site — this workspace's recurring failure mode is a correction that fixes one site and leaves a stronger false claim nearby.

The machine is under heavy load (many parallel runs, swap-exhausted); prefer reading files and the probe outputs (/tmp/alb_r8.out, /tmp/alb_ax2.out, /tmp/alb_build.out) over launching new builds. If you do build, expect 2-25 min.
